notes: Family Planner now runs in Home Assistant, and chores earn TiviSync TV time.

items: Family Planner now runs inside Home Assistant, with its own tab in the sidebar and sign-in with your Home Assistant login
Chores you tick off add the same number of minutes to your TiviSync TV time for today
Extra jobs are checked by an adult (on their phone, TV or here) before they count, then they add TV time too
Jobs that are an hour late are read out on your speaker, and chores and today's reminders pop up on TiviSync
When an admin ticks off a job for everyone, it now only counts for the person it was for, so it stays on everyone else's list
Admins can see who still has to do a job for everyone
Cleaners can add an extra job they did that wasn't on their list
Clocking in and out has been removed
Admins are now told when a chore is marked as done
Cleaning hours are now estimated from the minutes on each chore
Rooms now show when each chore was last done and by who
Who is out tomorrow now replaces Working tomorrow and School tomorrow
